cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Weather, marriage, or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One-time or renewable reassurance? I'll amend the request.
